player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Turin''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.

starting.card: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place

description: I Checked out Sith Fury when Tatooine came out and worked up a deck the day after. I wanted to keep it secret but I saw some decks popping up on here and although they were'nt as good as mine, I decided I had to get credit for one of my idea's.
cards: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place, Death Star II: Throne Room, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Prepared Defenses, Crush The Rebellion, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points; these count toward the 60.
The list names 41 cards; the last section is posted only as 'Seven's (19)' (19 unnamed destiny-7 cards for this '7's' deck). Kept as one UNKNOWN row of 19 as written, so the total is 60.

Posted 'DSIIDB' dested Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'CCDB' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'TatDB' the Dark Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark); 'EndorDB' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark).

Posted 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Darth Vader,DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Tech Mor' Tech Mo'r; 'Twilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Evader & Monnock' Evader & Monnok; 'Counter Assualt' Counter Assault.
Secret Plans is the 2001 Special Edition Effect (not a Defensive Shield).
The strategy's UPDATE swaps a Vader's Anger for a Rise, My Friend; the list is kept as originally published (Vader's Anger x2).
The published title masks the mild word 'bastards'; kept as published (precedent: 19442).
